title: UI and Frontend
summary: This module handles the user interface, including rendering chat responses, managing UI state, and serving frontend assets. It interacts with the backend for chat operations and authentication.

nodes.label: Chat Response Codegen
nodes.title: Chat Response Code Generation
nodes.description: Generates TypeScript classes for chat responses from Go types, ensuring type safety and consistency between frontend and backend data structures.

nodes.label: Display Stale Component
nodes.title: Stale Model Display
nodes.description: A React component that informs users when a newer model version is available and provides an option to update it, enhancing user experience and model currency.

nodes.label: useChats Hook
nodes.title: Chat State Management Hook
nodes.description: A React hook that manages the loading and streaming state of chats, optimizing UI updates and preventing unnecessary loading indicators based on recent activity.

nodes.label: Server Chat Handler
nodes.title: Chat Request Handler
nodes.description: Processes incoming chat requests, manages chat history, handles model pulling, and streams responses back to the client, including tool execution and thinking states.

nodes.label: Server Get Chat Handler
nodes.title: Get Chat History Handler
nodes.description: Retrieves a specific chat's history from the data store, reconstructs browser state if necessary, and prepares it for display in the frontend.

nodes.label: Authentication Middleware
nodes.title: Authentication Middleware
nodes.description: Secures API endpoints by validating authentication tokens in incoming requests, ensuring only authorized access to server resources.

groups.label: Frontend Components
groups.title: Frontend User Interface Components
groups.description: React components and hooks responsible for rendering the user interface and managing client-side state.

groups.label: Backend API Handlers
groups.title: Backend API Endpoints
groups.description: Go handlers that expose API endpoints for chat interactions and data retrieval, forming the interface between frontend and core logic.

groups.label: Data Serialization
groups.title: Data Serialization and Type Generation
groups.description: Handles the generation of client-side types for backend data structures, ensuring consistent data contracts.
